tei:div.tei:p: nyi dkyil thim zhing gnyis ka 'dres: lnga ldan thig le 'od zer 'phro ba ni: je chung je chung khab rtse'i khyon tsam bsam: dmigs med ngang du ngal gso dge ba bsngo: nangs bzhin ma chag dus min bar chad sel: zhag grangs bsgrubs na lo mang tshe bsring zhing: yi dam bsten na 'pho chen 'od lus 'grub: ghu rus gzhan du ma bstan tshe sgrub 'di: ma 'ongs phyi ma'i don du bdag nyid kyis: dung shog dkar po'i ngos su 'di bkod do: gdams so gtad do gter srung dregs pa'i tshogs: sā mā yā: ྈ nyi zla ga'u'i rgya: ྈ lnga ldan thig le'i rgya: mi dmigs pa'i rgya: rgya gsum gyis dam par bsdams te: dam chos dgongs pa yang zab kyi sgrub pa po mched lcam rnams la gtad do:

'bri gung bya bral bas bu tshal pho brang du dag par phab pa lags// 1$0000250༄// 'chi med tshe'i skor gyi dbang: gnad zab tshe'i dbang bskur gyi las byang dbang dang bcas pa bzhugs so// 1$0000300 zangs shog dmar po'i chos sder 'du'o// ghu ru tshe dpag med la na mo/ 'chi med tshe yi phyi dbang bskur ba'i phyir/ tshe gtor tshe chang tshe ril mda' dar sogs 'du byas la/ hrīḥ sku gsum bla ma tshe dpag med// bdag cag 'gro rnams skyabs su mchi// 'gro kun 'chi med thob bya'i slad// bdag gis lam 'dir 'bad par bya// zhes lan gsum bya/ bgegs la gtor ma byin gyis brlabs shing bsngo/ hrīḥ 'chi med sgrub la bar gcod pa'i// dam sri log 'dren 'byung po'i tshogs// gtor ma 'di khyer gzhan du dengs// gal te mi 'gro nyams par bgyi// bdag nyid dbang chen khros pa'i rdzu// 'phrul gyi khro tshogs stong gsum khengs// bgegs kyi gshed ma 'jigs rngams tshul// rdo rje rwa gur sra zhing brtan// sarba bhū ta gats+tsha badz+ra rak+ṣa kurban+tu/ zhes bka' bsgo mtshams bcad/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐/ nas/ shab+da āḥhūm̐ gi bar ro// oṃ āḥhūm̐ sarba pañtsa a mṛta ma hā rak+ta dz+wa la maṇ+ḍa la ma hā ba liṃ ta te dzo ba liṃ ta ba la ba te gu h+ya sa ma ya hūm̐ hrīḥṭhāḥ zhes mchod gtor sogs byin brlab/ bdag mdun dbyer med du bsgom pa ni/ hūm̐/ bdag dang gtor ma stong 'byams 'od gsal ngang*// pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan la skad cig gis// rig 'dzin pad+ma dkar ser mdangs dang ldan// rin chen rus pa'i rgyan can yid 'ong ba// mnyam gzhag phyag gis tshe bum mda' dar 'dzin// rdor skyil pang du lha lcam man+dhā ra// dmar ser 'od zer bcu drug lon pa'i nyams// nu ma 'bur zhing bha ga rab tu rgyas// rin chen rus rgyan yid 'ong pad skyil 'khyil// phyag gnyis tshe bum 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud// yab yum stong gsal bde ba'i nyams dang ldan// yab kyi spyi mgrin snying lte gsang gnas lngar// dkar dmar sngo ser ljang ba'i pad sdong brtsegs// bde chen 'khor lor sangs rgyas tshe dpag med// dkar po kun bzang dkar mo yum dang sbyor// longs spyod 'khor lor pad+ma tshe dpag med// dmar po gos dkar yum dang gnyis med 'khril// chos kyi 'khor lor rdo rje tshe dpag med// sngon po mā ma kī 'khyud sbyor ba'i tshul// sprul pa'i 'khor lor rat+na tshe dpag med// ser po sangs rgyas spyan dang dga' bar 'khril// bde skyong 'khor lor karma tshe dpag med// ljang khu sgrol ma yum dang mnyam par sbyor// yab rnams mnyam gzhag tshe bum rdor skyil pang*// yum rnams g.yas pa mda' dar rang mdog can// g.yon rnams tshe bum pad skyil yab la 'khril// kun kyang longs sku'i cha lugs mtshan dper ldan// gnas lngar oṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā rnams las// dkar dmar sngo ser ljang ba'i 'od 'phros pas// pad+ma 'od nas ye shes spyan drangs bstim// hrīḥ

phyogs bcu dus bzhi'i rgyal ba kun gyi dngos// 'chi med pad+ma 'byung gnas tshe dpag med// rigs lnga'i tshogs bcas gnas 'dir dgyes gshegs bzhugs// bdag cag gus pas 'dud cing phyag bgyi 'o// oṃ badz+ra gu ru pañtsa ā yuḥdhe wa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan/ a ti pū hoḥ pra ti dza hoḥ hrīḥ thugs rje smad byung tshe lha 'khor bcas la// mchod yon zhabs bsil me tog spos mar me// dri chab zhal zas rol mo 'dod yon lnga// sman raka gtor tshogs 'dod yon mchod par 'bul// oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ nas/ shab+da/ rū pa/ shab+da/ gan+dhe/ ra sa/ spar+she/ pañtsa a mṛta ma hā ru dhi ra ma hā ba liṃ ta khā hi/ hrīḥ 'chi med dbang po grub mchog pad+ma 'byung*// yab yum gnas lngar rigs kyi tshe dpag med// yum bcas longs spyod rdzogs sku mtshan dpe rdzogs// ma bsgribs chu zla ji bzhin snang la bstod// ces bstod/ lha rnams gnas lnga'i sa bon las 'od zer// sna tshogs phyogs bcur 'phros pas 'khor 'das kyi// snod bcud tshe dpal 'byor pa kun bsdus nas// thim pas 'chi med rig 'dzin thob par bsam/ bdag don du tshe sgrub byed na bzlas pa'i dmigs pa bsdus pa 'di'i tshab tu/ gter gzhung gi 'dod chags la brten nas tshe sgrub pa'i dngos gzhi'i dmigs pa rnams sbyor ba zhal las dris shig / oṃ bud+dha ā yur+dzñā na tshe bh+rūm̐ hūm̐: bud+dha'i gnas su/ pad+ma/ badz+ra/ rat+na/ karma sbyar la bsnyen pa nus tshad 'bad de byed/ tshogs kyi yo byad/ raṃ yaṃ khaṃ gis sbyang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ gsum gsum brjod pas byin brlabs tshogs phud 'bul/ hrīḥ 'dod yon tshogs kyi mchod pa ni// sna tshogs nam mkha'i khams bkang nas// 'chi med lha tshogs rnams la 'bul// dgyes shing tshim par bzhes nas kyang*// thugs dam skongs la bar chad sol// 'chi med tshe yi dngos grub stsol// oṃ badz+ra gu ru pañtsa ā yur+dhe wa ga ṇa tsakra pū dza pra tīts+tsha hoḥ

zhes dbul longs spyod/ lhag ma bsdus/ oṃ a kā ro lan gsum dang*/ hrīḥ tshogs kyi lhag ma pham phab bza' btung bcas// 'chi med bdag po'i bka' nyan 'khor tshogs la// legs par 'bul gyis tshims shing rangs gyur nas// bdag gi tshe yi bar gcod zhi bar mdzod// uts+tshiṣ+ṭa sarba sa pa ri wā ra khā hi: zhes dbul slob dpon bdag 'jug blang*// slob mas khrus byas gdan la 'khod// bgegs gtor byin la maṇ+ḍal dbul// gsol gdab dris len byin dbab cing*// dmigs pa dang bcas tshe 'gugs pa'i// bar rnams tshe dbang dkyus bzhin bya// dngos gzhi dbang bskur 'di ltar bya// gtor ma ghu ru yab yum gyi gnas lngar tshe dpag med rigs lnga yab yum rnams gsal ba'i spyi bo'i bud+dha tshe dpag med kyi phyag gi bum pa nas bdud rtsi dkar po babs pas ghu ru yab yum gyi sku gang*/ sbyor mtshams dang bum pa nas bdud rtsi dkar po bab/ slob ma ghu ru yab yum gyi spyi bo'i bud+dha tshe dpag med kyi phyag gi bum par bab/ bum pa gang zhing lud pas slob ma'i spyi bo'i pad 'dab khengs/ de las kyang bdud rtsi dkar po babs pas mgo bo'i nang thams cad bdud rtsi dkar gsal bkrag mdangs dang ldan pas gang*/ gti mug gi nyes ltung sbyangs/ rnam par shes pa'i khams dang*/ 'byung ba nam mkha'i khams nas tshe nyams pa sor chud/ me long lta bu'i 'khor 'das yongs grol gyi rang byung gzhi'i dga' ba'i ye shes thob/ ghu ru rnam snang tshe dpag med kyi rang bzhin mngon du byas par bsams la/ oṃ: sku yi dbang mchog bud+dha tshe dpag med: sogs kyi dbang ltar spyi bor bskur/ de bzhin pad+ma tshe dpag med kyi= bdud rtsi dmar po= mgrin pa'i pad+ma tshe dpag med= mgrin pa'i pad 'dab= mgrin pa'i dkyil 'khor thams cad bdud rtsi dmar gsal= 'dod chags kyi nyes ltung thams cad= drod kyi khams dang 'byung ba me'i khams= so sor rtog pa'i lhan skyes kyi dga' ba bzhi'i ye shes=

ghu ru pad+ma tshe dpag med kyi= ā: gsung gi dbang mchog pad+ma tshe dpag med: sogs/ yang*/ rdo rje tshe dpag med kyi= bdud rtsi sngon po= snying ga'i rdo rje tshe dpag med= snying ga'i pad 'dab= lte ba yan snying ga phyin lag sor tshun bdud rtsi mthing gsal= zhe sdang gi nyes ltung= khrag gi khams dang 'byung ba chu'i khams= chos dbyings dga' bral gyi ye shes= ghu ru rdo rje tshe dpag med kyi= hūm̐: thugs kyi dbang mchog rdo rje tshe dpag med: sogs/ yang*/ rat+na tshe dpag= bdud rtsi ser po= lte ba'i rat+na tshe dpag med kyi= lte ba'i pad 'dab= lte ba man spu mtshams yan bdud rtsi ser gsal= nga rgyal dang ser sna'i nyes ltung= sha dang rus pa'i khams dang 'byung ba sa'i= mnyam nyid kyi mchog dga'i ye shes= ghu ru rat+na tshe dpag med kyi= trāṃ: yon tan dbang mchog rat+na tshe dpag med: sogs/ yang*/ karma tshe dpag med kyi= bdud rtsi ljang gu= gsang gnas kyi karma tshe dpag med= gsang gnas kyi pad 'dab= rkang sor nas long bu pus mo dpyi dang gsang gnas phyin bdud rtsi ljang gsal= phrag dog gi nyes ltung= dbugs kyi khams dang 'byung ba rlung gi khams= bya ba grub pa'i bde stong gi dga' ba'i ye shes= gu ru karma tshe dpag med kyi= ā: phrin las dbang mchog karma tshe dpag med: sogs dkyus ltar bskur/ de rjes tshe chang dang tshe ril yang rigs lnga'i sngags bzlas shing sbyin/ ye dhar dang su pra tiṣ+ṭha sa me tog gtor zhing brtan par byas nas/ tshe dbang tshar grangs gsog na kun gyi tha mar dang/ de min rjes su/ gtor ma ghu ru yab yum du gsal ba'i gnas lnga'i tshe lha rigs lnga las lha rang rang 'dra ba re re spros te/ slob ma'i gnas lnga'i tshe dpag med rnams 'od du zhu ba rnams su thim ma thag /slob ma ghu ru yab yum du gsal ba yang 'od zer du gyur te/ lnga ldan thig le chen po stong gsal ti la ka nyag gcig gi rang mdangs su mnyam par gyur pa la/

tshe mda' srung ba'i lha mo lngas 'khor lo/ pad+ma/ rdo rje/ rin po che/ rgya gram rnams dkar dmar mthing ser ljang ba'i phyag rgyas btab pas 'dus byas la 'phral rkyen gyi 'tshe ba gang gis kyang mi tshugs shing gzhom gzhig dang bral ba rdo rje'i rang bzhin du gyur par bltas la/ bh+rūm̐: ye shes lha mo tshe mda' srung ba'i lha: sogs dkyus ltar gnas lngar gtugs/ dam tshig khas blang gtang rag dbul/ rjes ni/ bdag mdun lha la mchod cing bstod/ chad mdor sman rag sbran/ hrīḥ mā ra ti ka'i brag phug tu// slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas dang*// lha lcam man+dā ra ba yis// 'chi med rig 'dzin bsgrubs pa'i tshe/ khas blangs dam bcas srung ma'i tshogs// 'dir byon mchod gtor 'di bzhes la// 'chi med sgrub pa'i bar chad sol// oṃ ā yur maṇ+ḍa la rak+ṣan+tu pū dza khā hi/ zhes dbul tshogs gzhong sman 'bru dang*// gser skyems kyis bkang brtan ma bskyang*/ hrīḥ 'chi med pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis// bod yul skyong bar bka' bsgos pa'i// brtan ma chen mo bcu gnyis kyang*// ya ma skyong ma'i tshogs dang bcas// sman phran 'bum gyi 'khor gyis bskor// 'dir byon bdud rtsi'i mchod pa bzhes// rnal 'byor tshe yi bar gcod srungs// bod khams chos bzhin skyong bar mdzod// shā sa na sa pa ri wā ra pū dza khā hi// zhes dbul gtor gzhong sbub pa'i 'og /tshe bdud gzir mnan bro yis sbyang*/ hrīḥ 'chi med sgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor 'dir// gnod byed tshe bdud pho mo'i tshogs// dbang chen khros pa'i rta bro ni// rab 'bar 'jig rten g.yo zhing ldeg /mnan no ma ldang sa ma ya// oṃ āḥhūm̐ suṃ laṃ s+t+wam+bha ya nan: nongs bshags mdun bskyed bsdu ba ni/ hrīḥ ghu ru pad+ma yab yum dang// tshe lha rigs lnga'i tshogs bcas dgongs// bdag gis mi shes dbang gis ni// nyams par gyur gang bzod par bzhes// yi ge brgya pa lan gsum brjod/

hrīḥ gtor ma lha yi gnas lnga yi// rigs lnga tshe lha yab yum rnams// rang rang mdog can 'od du zhu// tshur 'phros bdag gi gnas lnga'i lhar// so sor thim pas 'jig med grub// gtor ma ghu ru yab yum yang*// 'od zhu bdag la thim pa'i mod// rang lus phyi nang lha rnams kyang*// 'od zhu lnga ldan thig le che// stong gsal ti la ka nyag gcig /rang mdangs ma bcos a la la// oṃ a kā ro sogs brjod/ thun mtshams rang sems snang ba'i cha// snang cha yab la stong cha yum// na bza' dkar mo'i nga rgyal ldan// shis brjod bsngo ba smon lam ni/ hrīḥ 'chi med rig 'dzin tshe dbang rtsal// ye shes tshe yi bkra shis stsol// gnas lngar rigs kyi tshe dpag med// rigs lnga tshe yi bkra shis stsol// rtsa gsum rgyal ba zhi khro'i tshogs// byin rlabs tshe dpal bkra shis stsol// dam can bka' srung gter bdag tshogs// bar chad kun sel bkra shis stsol// hrīḥ 'chi med sgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor 'dir// dus gsum rnam dkar dge ba'i tshogs// bsdus te khams gsum 'gro ba kun// 'chi med rig 'dzin thob phyir bsngo// zhes pa'i las byang phyi dbang gi /mtshams sbyor bcas 'di kho bos bgyis// 'di yi gter gzhung nyid du yang*// 'di la dgos pa'i tshe yi las gzhung yang: rgyas par byed na 'grel pa'i sgron me sbor: zhes gsungs phyir na rgyas par 'dod rnams kyi// ched du 'di bris bsdus pa la dga' na// gter byon nyid kyis dgos pa mchog tu 'grub// 'di rtsom byed po 'bri gung kyu ra'i rigs// shākya'i dge slong chos kyi grags pa zhes// gyi nar gyur pas 'khrul blo dang bral ba// rig 'dzin pad+ma'i dgongs pa 'khrul med bkod// 'di la 'ga' 'gas las gzhung dbang gi khrigs// sna tshogs brkus pa'i rtsom la 'thad mi 'thad// gter bdag srung ma'i tshogs kyis gnya' bor mdzod// de skad sa byi dbyar tha'i tshes bcu la// pho brang rtse bar bris dges 'gro ba kun// 'chi med rig 'dzin rdo rje'i sa thob shog

/tshe dbang 'chi bdag zil gnon 'di la bshes gnyen phal gyis ngag 'don rgyas par ni 'dod/ byed lugs ni ma shes par/ tshe dpag med rigs lnga'i dbang gi dag par bde mchog sogs sna tshogs spu tshogs 'gebs pa zhig snang mod/ de ni ches cher mi rigs la/ ngag 'don rgyas par 'dod na tshul 'di ni gter gzhung 'di ka'i 'dod chags la brten nas tshe sgrub pa'i skabs kyis kha bskangs pas rnam dpyod dang ldan pa'i rgyas bshad du thag chod pas rang gis rang la yid ches so ang*// sarba maṅga laṃ// //
